name: mineru-extract
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：mineru-extract。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Use the official MinerU (mineru.net) parsing API to convert a URL (HTML pages like WeChat articles, or direct PDF/Office/image links) into clean Markdown + structured outputs. Use when web_fetch/browser can’t access or extracts messy content, and you want higher-fidelity parsing (layout/table/formula/OCR).
